title: Reacting to News and Social Problems
goal: Put your reactions together to talk about news and social problems.

items: I can talk about news and social problems by giving the fact first and my reaction second.
I can choose between me preocupa que..., lamento que..., ¡Qué pena que...! and el hecho de que...
I can use the new words for social problems.
